parameters.gold: σ Daily transition rate E1→E2 and E2→I1 (two-stage latent period)
parameters.extracted: σ Daily rate of progression through latent (exposed) stages: E₁→E₂ and E₂→I₁ (implies mean incubation period d_L = 2*(1/σ) days)

parameters.gold: γ Daily transition rate I1→I2 and I2→R (two-stage infectious period)
parameters.extracted: γ Daily rate of progression through infectious stages: I₁→I₂ and I₂→R (implies mean infectious period d_I = 2*(1/γ) days)

parameters.gold: β Transmission rate in λ(t)=β*I(t)/N (homogeneous mixing)
parameters.extracted: β Transmission rate parameter (rate at which new infections take place given a contact); used in λ(t)=β I(t)/N
